name: @thetis/skills
description: The skill format and library: reads SKILL.md packs from packages and the home, lints them, ranks them, and offers skill_fetch so any loader shares one way to read a skill in full.

tools.name: skill_fetch
tools.description: Read the full text of a skill, or one of the files beside it, by id. A brief in the prompt is a pointer, not the content: fetch before relying on a skill. Returns up to 24000 characters per call; a footer says how to read on with offset.

id.description: The skill id as shown in the prompt, for example packages or packages/forks.

file.description: A file beside SKILL.md, as listed at the end of the skill's text, for example references/install.md.

offset.description: Character offset to read on from, as the footer of a previous call gave it.
